title: Tough and self-healing waterborne polyurethane elastomers via hydrogen bonds and oxime–carbamate design for wearable flexible strain sensors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6231-6240
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA09084E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wei Zhang, Mengqing Ren, Ming Chen, Lili Wu
A rigid-soft phase-separated structure with multilayered rigid and flexible supramolecular segments was designed and achieved high self-healing efficiency and mechanical properties. And, it has the potential to be used in electronic skin.
